summary: This code creates a basic web API using FastAPI that responds to GET requests at the root URL with a simple JSON message. When someone visits the root path, the server will return a dictionary containing a greeting.

explanations.3: FastAPI() creates an instance of the web application — think of it as starting up your API server that will handle incoming requests.
explanations.5: @app.get("/") is a decorator that tells FastAPI 'when someone makes a GET request to the root path, run the function below this'.
explanations.8: The function returns a Python dictionary, which FastAPI automatically converts to JSON and sends back to the client as the response.
